featured_reviews.name: Namz Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a small beautiful church located in the quiet interiors of Pantnagar. It is frequented by most of the local christian populace of the area who have been coming to this church since generations back. So the place holds lots of fond memories for everyone who's visiting or who's visited. It has a school attached to it called Dominic Savio Vidyalaya. Which also happens to be my alma mater, my school. This place hold lots of memories for me as it does for the many many children/adults who have attended the school, walked the hallways, attended moral science seminars in the church and kneeled and prayed in the pews. So this place will always have a hold on my childhood memories.😊

featured_reviews.name: Alvin Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been attending st.anthony church sakinaka for the past 15 years, and it has been a truly enriching experience. The community is incredibly welcoming and supportive, making newcomers feel right at home. The services are inspiring and thought-provoking, with sermons that are both insightful and relevant to everyday life.

The pastoral team is genuinely caring and takes the time to get to know each member of the congregation. I also appreciate the variety of programs and activities available for all age groups, from children's ministries to adult Bible studies.

If you're looking for a place to grow spiritually and connect with a wonderful community, I highly recommend st Anthony church sakinaka

featured_reviews.name: Relvin D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
St. John the Evangelist Church is a true gem and a serene sanctuary in the heart of our community. From the moment you step through the doors, you're enveloped in an atmosphere of peace and spirituality that is both uplifting and calming.

The architecture of the church is simply stunning. The intricate stained glass windows cast colorful patterns of light that dance across the beautifully maintained interior, creating a sacred and tranquil space for worship and reflection. The attention to detail in the design is evident in every corner, from the ornate altar to the meticulously crafted wooden pews.

The community at St. John the Evangelist is warm and welcoming. The parishioners are friendly and inclusive, always ready with a smile and a kind word. The sense of fellowship and unity here is palpable, making newcomers feel like they've found a second home. The church is also very active, offering a wide range of programs and events for all ages. Whether it's the engaging Sunday School for children, the thought-provoking Bible study groups, or the vibrant community outreach programs, there's something for everyone.

The leadership at St. John the Evangelist is outstanding. The clergy are not only deeply knowledgeable and passionate about their faith, but they also take the time to connect personally with members of the congregation. Their sermons are both inspiring and relevant, providing guidance and insight that resonate long after the service has ended.

Music at St. John the Evangelist deserves special mention. The choir is exceptional, and the organ music adds a majestic touch to the services. The acoustics in the church are perfect, allowing the music to fill the space in a way that lifts the spirit and enhances the worship experience.
